title: Atlas benchmark report
description: A result with no K and no baseline beside it is rhetoric. This shape makes both structural: `k` is how many comparisons were made, `baseline` is what the number has to beat to mean anything, and every arm declares HOW it was obtained — measured by an instrument, produced by a declared model, or not run at all. An arm that was not run carries no numbers, because a blank and a zero read the same in a table.

k.description: Comparisons made. Printed on every search, because a 5% bar over K cells yields 0.05K false winners.

held_out.description: A suite you select on is in-sample. This is the part nothing was tuned against.

obtained_by.description: `instrument` is measured here. `declared_model` is computed from a stated assumption and is NOT a measurement. `not_run` needs a real agent, and says so instead of printing a zero.

model.description: Required for declared_model: the assumption, stated so it can be attacked.
